full_judgment: 14. It is of course the general rule of judicial procedure that the trial should not be held piecemeal so that the litigation may not be protected. Where the parties to a suit are at issue on several questions, all such questions should be heard together and disposed of by one judgment so that in case of the reversal of the trial Court's decision on certain issues, there may not be any necessity for demand of the suit for the disposal of the undisposed of issues.
